m: एणाङ्क m. ‘deer-marked’, the moon, BhP.

a: एणी — 1 A female black deer. --2 A kind of poisonous insect. --Comp. --पद a. having feet like those of a deer. --(दः) a kind of snake.

m: एणी—दाह m. a kind of fever, Bhpr.

एणीक, एणीकीय, Pat. on Pāṇ. ii, 4, 14.
एणी—नयन mf(आ)n. id.
एणी—˚पचनीय mfn. belonging to the above tribe, Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 1, 75.

m: एण अस्, ई, m. f. a species of deer or antelope (described as being of a black colour with beautiful eyes and short legs), AV. v, 14, 11; VS. xxiv, 36; Mn. iii, 269; MBh. &c.
एण m. (in astron.) Capricorn.
a: एणः, एकणः — 1 A kind of black antelope; the several kinds of deer are given in this verse: --अनृचो माणवो ज्ञेय एणः कृष्णमृगः स्मृतः . रुरुर्गौरमुखः प्रोक्तः शंबरः शोण उच्यते ... --2 (In astr.) Capricorn. --Comp. --अजिनं deerskin. --तिलकः, --भृत् the moon; so ˚अंकः, ˚लांछनः &c. --ट्टश् a. one having eyes like those of a deer. (--m.) Capricorn.

एण—दृश् m. (क्) (in astron.) Capricorn.
एण—जङ्घ m. ‘deer-legged’, N. of a running messenger, Daś.
